CAPES.name: Apprentice’s Mantle
CAPES.lore: A plain grey mantle, sewn by someone who believed in you.

CAPES.name: Journeyman’s Mantle
CAPES.lore: Stitched with the small marks of every trade you have tried.

CAPES.name: Cape of Coffin-Oak
CAPES.lore: Mastery of the axe. It smells faintly of sawdust and old promises.

CAPES.name: Cape of Grave-Iron
CAPES.lore: Mastery of the pick. Heavy, and cold to the touch.

CAPES.name: Cape of the Black Water
CAPES.lore: Mastery of the line. It is always a little damp.

CAPES.name: Cape of the Sexton
CAPES.lore: Mastery of the spade. The dead are quiet around it.

CAPES.name: Cape of the Mourning Bed
CAPES.lore: Mastery of the garden. Something is always growing on it.

CAPES.name: Cape of the Alembic
CAPES.lore: Mastery of the brew. It shifts colour when you are not looking.

CAPES.name: Cape of the Bone Grinder
CAPES.lore: Mastery of the grinder. Nothing is wasted, and nothing stays whole.

CAPES.name: The Sexton’s Mantle
CAPES.lore: Ninety-nine in every rite. The Covenant has no higher thanks to give.

PETS.name: Tithe Bat
PETS.lore: It roosts in the coffin-oaks and follows the sound of the axe.

PETS.name: Grave Rat
PETS.lore: It found a better seam than you did, and it will not tell you where.

PETS.name: Drowned Pup
PETS.lore: Pulled from black water, still wet, still hopeful.

PETS.name: Wee Thrall
PETS.lore: A very small skeleton with a very large sense of duty.

PETS.name: Shroud Moth
PETS.lore: It drinks the light from the beds and gives a little back.

charm_tithe_bat.name: Tithe Bat Charm
charm_tithe_bat.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Tithe Bat is yours for good. It roosts in the coffin-oaks and follows the sound of the axe.

charm_grave_rat.name: Grave Rat Charm
charm_grave_rat.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Grave Rat is yours for good. It found a better seam than you did, and it will not tell you where.

charm_drowned_pup.name: Drowned Pup Charm
charm_drowned_pup.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Drowned Pup is yours for good. Pulled from black water, still wet, still hopeful.

charm_wee_thrall.name: Wee Thrall Charm
charm_wee_thrall.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Wee Thrall is yours for good. A very small skeleton with a very large sense of duty.

charm_shroud_moth.name: Shroud Moth Charm
charm_shroud_moth.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Shroud Moth is yours for good. It drinks the light from the beds and gives a little back.
